title: "What actually happened the first time I looked at all of it properly"
pubDate: 2026-06-29
description: "Not a method. A description of the thirty minutes that changed how I work with money."
tags: ["money avoidance", "honest reckoning"]

I had seven tabs open and I closed six of them.

The one I left open was a spreadsheet I had not updated in four months. The cursor sat in cell B3 and I did not type anything for about two minutes. That is not a technique. It is what actually happened.

The number in B3 was smaller than I had been telling myself it was, in the vague, unexamined way you tell yourself things when you are not looking directly at them. I had known, in that same vague way, that it would be. That is why the tab had been sitting there unopened.

What I did not expect was the steadiness that came after. Not relief. Not a plan. Just the particular quiet of a thing that is no longer hypothetical.
